pages.text: $(italic)Pure melee investment. Best for Berserker, Vanguard, Samurai and Paladin.$()$(br2)Every node is an attribute and applies the moment you take it.$(br2)The tree has 29 nodes: an 8-node trunk, then two branches of 11 and 10 nodes, each ending in a capstone that costs 2 points.

pages.title: Trunk
pages.text: $(bold)Brute Force$() I and II: +5% melee damage each$(br2)$(bold)Iron Grip$() I and II: +5% attack speed each$(br2)$(bold)Thick Hide$() I and II: +4% melee resistance each$(br2)$(bold)Vigor$() I and II: +2 max health each

pages.title: Life Steal Branch
pages.text: $(bold)Relentless Strikes$() I to III: +6% melee damage each$(br)$(bold)Bloodlust$() I to III: +1%, +2% and +2% life steal$(br)$(bold)Ferocity$() I and II: +6% attack speed each$(br)$(bold)Savage Blows$() I and II: +8% melee damage each$(br2)$(bold)Capstone: Unending Fury$(), +15% melee damage and +5% life steal.

pages.title: Critical Branch
pages.text: $(bold)Precision$() I to III: +1 luck each$(br)$(bold)Sword Mastery$() I and II: +8% sword damage each$(br)$(bold)Axe Mastery$() I and II: +8% axe damage each$(br)$(bold)Lethal Edge$() I and II: +8% and +12% crit damage$(br2)$(bold)Capstone: Perfect Strike$(), +2 luck and +20% crit damage.
